# <span id="aanchor204"></span> County Editor

The County Editor allows you to enter county names that you can then access in areas throughout FLOWCAL, such as the Meter Editor and Location Editor.

<div class="procedure">

To access the County Editor and modify county options:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  Select **County Editor** in the **Geographic** group.
3.  Select a county from the list and click the **Edit** button.
4.  Update the county data at the bottom of the screen as needed.
5.  Click the **Save** button.

To create a new county:

1.  Click the **New** button.

2.  Enter the county data using the fields at the bottom of the screen.

    The code is generally the Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS) county code, which is used by the United States government to uniquely identify states and counties.

3.  Click the **Save** button. The county will now be available within FLOWCAL.
